description: This file implements a WebSocket-based speech recognition SDK with JSON message handling, session management, and device control commands. It defines functions for creating, updating, sending, and destroying speech session objects, as well as handling incoming messages and events related to speech recognition and device control.

classes.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_obj_t
classes.description: Internal structure representing a WebSocket speech recognition session object, including JSON message templates, handlers, state variables, and configuration data.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_object_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the given object is valid by verifying its identifier.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new WebSocket speech recognition session object with provided parameters.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_handlers
methods.description: Sets up callback handlers for the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_user_data
methods.description: Updates the user data pointer associated with the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_json
methods.description: Updates a JSON object with a new key-value pair.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_json_str
methods.description: Updates a JSON object with a string value for a given key.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_device_id
methods.description: Sets or updates the device ID in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_account_id
methods.description: Sets or updates the account ID in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_device_type
methods.description: Sets the device type (STB or TV) in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_partner_id
methods.description: Sets the partner ID in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_experience
methods.description: Sets the experience string in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_audio_profile
methods.description: Sets the audio profile in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_audio_model
methods.description: Sets the audio model in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_audio_rf_protocol
methods.description: Sets the RF protocol in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_language
methods.description: Sets the language in the session object.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_init_app
methods.description: Loads and sets an application-specific JSON blob.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_send_msg
methods.description: Sends a message string over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the session object.
